statements.subject: server
statements.description: The Broker MUST verify the validity of the token either locally (e.g., in the case of a self-contained token) or MAY send a request to the introspection endpoint of the AS (as described for HTTP-based interactions in Section 5.9 of the ACE framework [RFC9200]).

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The Broker MUST verify the validity of the token either locally (e.g., in the case of a self-contained token) or MAY send a request to the introspection endpoint of the AS (as described for HTTP-based interactions in Section 5.9 of the ACE framework [RFC9200]).

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The Broker MUST verify the claims in the access token according to the rules set in Section 5.10.1.1 of the ACE framework [RFC9200].

statements.subject: server
statements.description: For self-contained tokens, the Broker MUST process the security protection of the token first, as specified by the respective token format, i.e., a CWT uses COSE, while a JWT uses JOSE.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: HMAC-SHA-256 (HS256) [RFC6234] and Ed25519 [RFC8032] are mandatory to implement for the Broker.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The Client MUST implement at least one of them depending on the choice of symmetric or asymmetric validation.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Validation of the signature or MAC MUST fail if the signature algorithm is set to "none" when the key used for the signature algorithm cannot be determined or the computed and received signature/MAC do not match.
statements.pre_cond: signature.algorithm = none | token.signing_key.undetermined = true | signature.computed != signature.received

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The Broker MUST check if the access token is still valid, if it is the intended destination (i.e., the audience) of the token, and if the token was issued by an authorized Authorization Server.
statements.post_cond: token.not_expired = true & token.audience_valid = true & token.issuer_authorized = true

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The "cnf" claim MUST contain either the Client's RPK or, if the key is already known by the Broker (e.g., from previous communication), a reference to it.
